description:
Web/UI Developer 
 Everett, WA 
 6 month contract 
 
 Summary: 
 • Are you an experienced Web UI developer who can deliver high-performance, intuitive UI design and implementation, who also possesses some .NET C# knowledge
 • Client is looking for a talented software engineer to assist in designing and creating the next generation of internal and external web applications to provision, manage, and deliver services to our subscribers.
 • 5 years UI design and development experience using the following web client technologies. AngularJS, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/LESS, bootstrap.
 • 2 years working with Microsoft ASP.NET 4.0 or newer in C# - Experience working with JSON and REST APIs
 • Strong communication both verbal and written, excellent organizational skills, proven experience in collaboration with teams to achieve end result 
 • Ability to work in fast-paced Agile/Iterative environment to deliver requirements on specified dates 
 • Work very well independently with strong self-direction and initiative as well as within a team
 • A strong desire to produce software that meets or exceeds expectations, and is delivered on time 
 • Find creative ways to bridge the client-server gap using unobtrusive techniques, client-side scripts, AJAX, and other available tools. 
 • Assist alongside the development team in standing up services in IIS through cookie-cutter ASP.NET Web APIs for JSON extending existing web methods 
 • Enterprise Service Bus and making them available for consumption by the client side application. 
 • Also help in adding and enhancing web services with session variable handling, logging and other basic operations
